VI.description: Run a VI and read back EVERY control and indicator value it holds afterwards\2C rendered as XML text.\0A\0AExists because RunVIAsTopLevel marshals only STRINGS. A boolean\2C cluster\2C array or waveform indicator comes back empty with errorCode 91 - after the VI has already run correctly - so the result of a generated VI is normally unreadable. This helper sidesteps that completely\3A it reads the values through VI Server and flattens them to XML\2C so everything leaves through a single STRING indicator that RunVIAsTopLevel can carry.\0A\0ASetting\2C running and reading MUST happen in one call\2C through one VI reference. Measured\3A a separate RunVIAsTopLevel followed by a separate read returns the target's DEFAULTS\2C not the values of the run - the two calls do not share the VI's data space.\0A\0AInput Names and Input Values are two newline-separated lists\2C paired by position. Two lists rather than one name=value list because AIXML cannot declare a 2D array. Values cross as strings\2C so the same limit as RunVIAsTopLevel applies on the way IN\3A only string controls can be set. The way OUT is unrestricted - that is the point of this helper.\0A\0ADriven by RunVIAsTopLevel. Opening and closing a VI REFERENCE releases the target\2C so this does not burn the target's path for a later regeneration.

Control.description: Absolute path of the VI to run\2C as a string. Converted to a path inside.
Names of the target's controls to set before running\2C one per line. Empty to run with whatever the VI already holds.
Values for Input Names\2C one per line\2C paired by position. Strings only - a numeric or path control cannot be set this way.

FreeLabel.comment: One Ctrl Val.Set per name/value pair. The error wire through the shift register is what orders them before Run VI.

Node.inputs: reference:20.vi reference,error in (no error):140.value,Wait until done:150.value

Indicator.description: Every control and indicator of the target after the run\2C name and value\2C as flattened XML. A STRING deliberately - that is what survives RunVIAsTopLevel.
This helper's own error cluster\2C flattened to XML. Flattened rather than passed as a cluster so that it too can be marshalled back.
